name: Dlouhá Loučka (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly into a yellow upper fly part and a grey lower hoist part, with a row of purple flowers along the division.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 6 January 2021 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
